description:
## [1.0.2](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/AppleMusic-DiLink/releases/tag/v1.0.2)

Metadata only: declares `apkFileType = XAPK` and the original APK SHA-256 signing fingerprints (Apple Inc. for API < 33, Google Inc. for API 33+), so Morphe Manager can reject modified or unrelated APKs before patching. Patch payload is unchanged from 1.0.1.
